fields.reasoning: The cause is in internal/run/checks.go pollCheck: on a resume, internal/api run_lost.go gives a check session that died unseen a lost exit, AgentStatus reports it Done with outcome fail, and pollCheck journals that judgement, so checkVerdict fails the check ('check failed: lost: ...') without reading the findings round and nextCheckActions opens cycle 2 over every check. Decision judge-sessions-ended-unseen already lets a lost agent step pass when the evidence of its work holds now (its until); a check's findings round, and a critic's verdicts, are that evidence for a checks step, recorded in the run's journal by rhiza run findings --check and rhiza run verdict --check. A lost exit's code is unknown, so without the recorded work it stays a fail, and known exits keep their meaning.
fields.statement: A check or critic session of a checks step that the run finds lost (an exit of state lost: it ended while no run watched it, as in a crash) is judged by the work it recorded rather than by its unknown exit: a lost check session is judged pass when the journal holds its findings round for that cycle, and a lost critic session is judged pass when the journal holds its verdict on every blocker and major finding of that round; checkVerdict then reads the round and the verdicts as for any passed session. A lost session without that recorded work, a session that exited with a known non-zero code, and a session that never read its start command are still judged fail. The done mark is not required, as a crash can come between rhiza run findings and rhiza session done.

fields.acceptance: New engine tests in internal/run/checks_test.go, run with go test -trimpath ./internal/run -run 'TestChecksStep|TestCritic|TestNextCheckActions': (1) a resumed checks step whose journal holds cycle 1 of three checks, each with its session and an empty findings round, and whose fake runner reports every session Done, Lost, outcome fail, passes in cycle 1: each check's judgement is pass, no cycle 2 entry is journalled and no check session is started; (2) a resumed step whose lost check session's round holds a major finding starts that check's critic, and a lost critic that recorded a verdict on that finding is judged pass and its verdict decides the check; (3) failure case: a lost check session with no findings round for the cycle is judged fail, and cycle 2 runs only that check; (4) failure case: a lost critic missing a verdict on a serious finding is judged fail and its check fails ('critic failed'); (5) failure case: a check session exiting with a known non-zero code (not lost) with a recorded round is still judged fail. The existing TestChecksStep* and TestCritic* tests pass unchanged.
fields.must_not: Judge a lost session pass without its recorded round (check) or verdicts (critic); change how a non-lost exit, a never-submitted session, an agent step, a leaf fixer or verifier, or a change-set fixer is judged; change AgentStatus, Rejoin or the lost exit in internal/api; change the cycle cap or which checks a later cycle runs.
fields.statement: A checks step judges a lost check session by its recorded findings round for the cycle and a lost critic session by its recorded verdicts, so resuming a run whose check sessions died in a crash after recording their rounds passes or fails each check on its round instead of failing the cycle and re-running every check.
